visual_logic.surface_detail: Smooth, dolphin-like skin with 'Indigo' dorsal tones and 'Cream' countershading. A subtle oily sheen suggests high-speed swimming.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Emphasis on the large, robust tail fluke and the specialized, paddle-like front flippers characteristic of platypterygiines.
visual_logic.environment: Deep blue oceanic water of the Neuquén Basin; high visibility with drifting marine snow.
visual_logic.pose: A powerful lateral bank, showing the full length of the aerodynamic body and the curve of the fluke.
